messages:
Priya Shah: quick heads-up — tenant admin asked for a way to issue read-only tokens scoped to specific routes (analytics only). Can we surface a 'route + method' scope in the console for roles?
Noah Kim: we already allow route prefixes in the API, but method-level filtering is backend-only today. UX would need checkboxes (GET/POST/PUT/DELETE) + an effective-perms preview. low complexity?
Marta Lopez: idea: role creation modal -> 'Add scope' -> pick 'Route' -> input prefix -> methods multi-select -> live example token preview. show 'effective permissions' panel that simulates a token.
Alex Rivera: API note: expose `scope_expr` and `methods` on the roles resource. example payload: 
```
POST /v1/roles
{
  "name": "analytics-readonly",
  "scopes": [{"type":"route","expr":"/api/v1/metrics/*","methods":["GET","HEAD"]}]
}
```
Noah Kim: +1. also require the audit log entry to include the literal scope expression so security can search by it (not just a human label).
Kevin O'Neal: enterprise concern: some customers want inherited scopes for service accounts (parent role -> child). do we model `inherit_from` or force explicit binds? risk of accidental privilege creep.
Marta Lopez: i'd lean explicit binds by default. we can add an "allow inheritance" toggle gated behind an enterprise feature flag and warn in the UI.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout started for role-editor-v2 -> prod (10%).
Priya Shah: ux question — advanced users want a raw expression editor (e.g. `tenant==\"acme\" && route.startsWith('/prod')`) while others prefer templates. propose templates + an 'advanced' toggle.
Alex Rivera: implementation sketch: 1) backend schema change to accept `methods` + `scope_expr`, 2) add /roles/preview endpoint to evaluate a token against scopes, 3) console modal + preview + audit text. i'll draft a short RFC and link it here.
Priya Shah: perfect — i'll file the RFC, add @Marta Lopez and @Alex Rivera to the ticket, and schedule work in sprint 52. :thumbsup:
